name: sheprd
description: Surfaces screenshots, preview URLs, finished results and blockers to the sheprd phone app, and forwards You should know notes there.

baseUrl.title: sheprd server URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the sheprd server; surfaces are POSTed to <baseUrl>/api/surface.

autoSurface.title: Auto-surface screenshots and dev servers
autoSurface.description: Surface (info level) a PNG/JPEG a Bash command just wrote, or a screenshot an MCP tool returned (at most one per minute), and a local dev server URL a foreground Bash command printed (once per port per session), without the model asking.

forwardYouShouldKnow.title: Forward You should know
forwardYouShouldKnow.description: Forward notes the built-in You should know mod shows above the prompt to the phone (attention level).
